name: Netlook
tagline: See who is on your Wi-Fi.
description: Netlook scans your Wi-Fi and lists every device that answers, with names from reverse DNS, NetBIOS, mDNS and UPnP, open ports and a guessed type such as printer, TV or camera. Name your devices, mark the ones you know, test their latency, and get an alert when a new one joins. Everything runs on your phone, with no account and no tracking.
